card_en: Directions come in the imperative, the form that tells someone what to do. The polite form, also for several people, ends in -te: pojdite, go; zavijte, turn. You only need to understand it.

example.en: Go straight on and turn left.

polite.en: Go straight on and turn left. (polite, or to several people)

to someone close.en: Go straight on and turn left. (to someone close)

quick_check.explain_en: Pojdite ends in -te, so it is polite, as for gospa; to someone close it is pojdi.

helper_de: Like German gehen Sie and geh: pojdite is polite or for several people, pojdi is for someone close.
helper_en: English go and turn never change; Slovenian adds -te for polite speech or several people.
